---
title: "Future Developments"
---

## Implemented Prototype Functions

The current development stage includes:

- creation and export of three-colour PNG patterns;
- embedded file selection through the GFX HAT display;
- PNG validation and colour-to-servo mapping on the Raspberry Pi;
- USB serial communication between Raspberry Pi and ESP32;
- direct control of three yarn-selection servomotors;
- microswitch-based pattern advancement;
- custom 3D-designed servo arms;
- a separately evaluated error-recognition pipeline.

## Next Integration Steps

| Development | Objective |
|---|---|
| Connect `notify_error()` to the real workflow | Pause the actuation when the vision detector identifies a defect |
| Integrate main stepper motor control | Automate the complete machine motion |
| Add alarm-safe stop/resume commands | Coordinate servo and motor movement after an error |
| Complete servo-arm calibration | Define validated `UP` and `DOWN` angles after final assembly |
| Publish CAD/STL files and photographs | Document mechanical reproducibility |
| Automatic program launch | Start the interface automatically when the Raspberry Pi boots |

## Target Closed-Loop Architecture

```text
PNG Pattern Selection
        ↓
Raspberry Pi Control Application
        ↓
ESP32 Actuation ── Servo and future Stepper Motion
        ↓
Hook-Level Camera Inspection
        ↓
Error Detection on Raspberry Pi
        ↓
Automatic Pause / Operator Feedback
```
